mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: dooverview() for the extended command 'overview' is not ported

summary: The new boundary is the missing dungeon.c dooverview() command. The assigned recording types #overview and at step 614 commits it with Return; C calls show_overview(0,0), recalculates mapseen, builds the Dungeons of Doom menu with Level 1/25/40, waits in PICK_NONE, and the next Escape dismisses it. JavaScript already has the extcmd row and M-O binding, but ADMITTED_COMMANDS, doextcmd dispatch, direct rhack handling, and the source-general overview renderer are missing. The existing end.js final-disclosure helper is explicitly partial and cannot supply normal overview branches. This is a source-general dungeon.c file-port with mapseen/menu wiring, not a seed-specific fix.

source.branch: For an ordinary in-progress #overview, iflags.menu_requested is false, so dooverview() calls show_overview(0,0), recalc_mapseen(), traverses non-endgame mapseen entries whose interest_mapseen() is true, renders source-ordered dungeon headings and level/feature/annotation/branch lines with print_mapseen(), then selects PICK_NONE. An m-prefixed overview uses why=-1 and PICK_ONE, assigning ledger values and routing a selected level to query_annotation(); the current witness takes the plain display-only branch and dismisses it with Escape.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1785-1791 and :2775 bind dooverview() to the overview extended-command row/Ctrl-O and M-O; js/extcmdlist_data.js:93 and js/command_bindings.js:30 carry those bindings.
nethack-c/upstream/src/dungeon.c:2571-2577 donamelevel() calls dooverview() when iflags.menu_requested; js/dungeon.js:1815-1826 currently refuses that branch.

nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:3727-3748 calls the resolved handler and the ECMD_OK result returns to the command loop; js/cmd.js:4892-5151 and :5189+ own extended/direct dispatch and currently omit dooverview.
dependencies: nethack-c/upstream/src/dungeon.c:3303-3728 show_overview/traverse/print_mapseen plus :2878-2923 interest_mapseen provide the menu data and filtering; js/dungeon.js:1958-2004 has only the current ordinary recalc_mapseen slice, while js/end.js:933-978 is a final-disclosure-only partial helper.

nethack-c/upstream/src/dungeon.c:3367-3476 seen_string(), br_string2(), endgamelevelname(), shop_string(), and tunesuffix() supply pure text and branch annotations; js/dungeon.js:558-571 already ports endgamelevelname(), but the other overview helpers are absent.

js/windows.js:77-82 add_menu_heading() and :122+ select_menu(), together with js/tty_menu.js:1449-1452 PICK_NONE handling, supply the display-only menu and Escape dismissal; use the source ordering and menu headings.

nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1785-1791 sets CMD_M_PREFIX, so wiring must preserve iflags.menu_requested: plain #overview is PICK_NONE while m#overview is PICK_ONE and may call the existing js/dungeon.js query_annotation() current/different-level paths.

nethack-c/upstream/src/dungeon.c:3292-3340 defines dooverview/show_overview: normal why=0 uses recalc_mapseen and PICK_NONE; an m-prefix uses why=-1 and PICK_ONE with query_annotation.

The implementation scope is source-general C behavior and production dispatch/menu wiring; do not special-case seed 4500, Knight role, input text, expected headings, or replay step.
